topic: How does imperfect CSIT from quantized feedback constrain real-time interference management capabilities in multibeam networks?
consensus_response: Imperfect Channel State Information (CSI) from quantized feedback introduces residual interference in multibeam networks, reducing system capacity and user satisfaction. The limited reference signal symbols compromise channel estimation accuracy, leading to suboptimal beamforming directions. This exacerbates interference issues, further reducing system capacity. In FDD systems with a large number of antennas at the base station, the coherence time limits the available reference signals, making it challenging to achieve accurate channel estimation and efficient interference management.
reference_context: The number of available reference signal symbols is fundamentally limited by the channel coherence time, leading to insufficient data for accurate channel estimation in FDD systems with a large number of antennas at the base station.
